content_sections.heading: What is MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is an apprenticeship training opportunity announced by Sanjay Gandhi Thermal Power Station (SGTPS), MPPGCL, Birsinghpur. The recruitment is conducted for Graduate Apprentice and Technician Apprentice categories under the Apprenticeship programme.

content_sections.heading: MPPGCL Apprentice Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Degree qualification in relevant engineering disciplines from a recognized university. Graduate candidates from general streams such as B.Pharm, BCA, BA (Arts), B.Com (Commerce) and B.Sc (Science) can also apply. Diploma qualification in relevant engineering disciplines from a recognized institute.

content_sections.heading: MPPGCL Apprentice Training Period
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training for a period of 12 months at Sanjay Gandhi Thermal Power Station (SGTPS), Birsinghpur.

content_sections.heading: MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required Graduate or Diploma qualification in the relevant discipline. The qualification should be completed as per the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. Candidates should submit the required documents along with the application form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official MPPGCL website. Fill the application form with correct details. Attach required documents, mark sheets and certificates. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification. The application should reach the concerned office before 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates Mark sheets Identity proof Category certificate (if applicable) Other required documents mentioned in the application form

content_sections.heading: MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted as per the rules and conditions mentioned in the official apprenticeship notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is an apprenticeship recruitment opportunity for Graduate Apprentice and Technician Apprentice posts at Sanjay Gandhi Thermal Power Station, Birsinghpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 27 apprentice vacancies are available for Graduate Apprentice and Technician Apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPPGCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPPGCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have the required Graduate Degree or Diploma qualification in relevant disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for MPPGCL Graduate Apprentice?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices will receive ₹12,300 per month during the apprenticeship training period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for MPPGCL Technician Apprentice?
faq.answer: Technician Apprentices will receive ₹10,900 per month during the apprenticeship training period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the training period of MPPGCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training period is 12 months.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for MPPGCL SGTPS Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting the filled application form along with required documents through offline mode.
